name: abundant
source:
Kyouko is a newly appointed school health physician. She uses aphrodisiac with the school's problem child to teach him a lesson. But as a result she herself gets abused in the health room every day with the act being shoot on a camera. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
恭子是新任命的学校保健医生。她对学校的问题儿童使用春药来教训他。但结果她自己每天都在保健室里受到虐待，这一行为被摄像机拍摄下来。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
